content.text: In regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal fail to serve, digital [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-first-principles-2|COREMERCH guide to creators]] face a significant challenge: how to establish a fully functional online store that accepts crypto [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-stack-started-generating-2|The Payment]]-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-10|payment]]s. This is particularly pressing in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela, where conventional payment methods are either unavailable or severely restricted. COREMERCH provides the solution with infrastructure that empowers you to deploy a digital commerce stack without relying on these platforms. With the right tools, you can set up your order database using Supabase, ensuring ownership and control over your data while enabling seamless transactions.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The COREMERCH infrastructure is designed to operate independently of traditional payment platforms, providing a robust solution for digital creators. In countries facing economic instability or restrictive payment gateways, this sovereignty is crucial. By using open-source tools like GitHub Pages and Supabase, you gain full ownership of your digital store without monthly fees or reliance on third-party platforms. This architecture ensures that your business can thrive, even in challenging environments, by enabling direct crypto payments and instant product delivery.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, gather the essential tools and resources. You will need a GitHub account to host your store, access to Google Apps Script for backend logic, and a NOWPayments account to facilitate crypto transactions. Ensure you have your digital products ready for upload, whether they are ebooks, courses, or software. Understanding the basics of Supabase will also be crucial, as it serves as your order database. With these components in place, you're set to build a solid foundation for your online store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, start by deploying your order database with Supabase. Create the necessary tables for orders, products, and customer data. Then, configure your Google Apps Script to handle incoming payment notifications from NOWPayments. This script will ensure that once a payment is confirmed, the corresponding product is delivered automatically to the customer. Testing this workflow on a test network is essential before going live, ensuring that all components work seamlessly together for a smooth customer experience.
Own your infrastructure — no monthly fees, no third-party dependencies.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up and tested, it’s time to go live. Update your GitHub Pages with the production-ready code and ensure all links to your Supabase database are correctly configured. Promote your online store through your channels, directing potential customers to your checkout page. When your first transaction occurs, monitor both the payment confirmation from NOWPayments and the product delivery from Supabase. This initial transaction will validate the entire setup and provide insights for any necessary adjustments.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your digital store operational, focus on scaling your infrastructure. Analyze customer data from Supabase to understand purchasing behavior and optimize your product offerings accordingly. Consider expanding your product range based on demand and enhancing your marketing strategies. You can also explore integrating additional features or services to improve customer engagement. Leveraging the Complete Builder Kit ($197) will provide you with advanced blueprints and templates to enhance your store further, ensuring you remain competitive and relevant in the digital marketplace.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Deploy in hours, not days — streamline your setup with COREMERCH.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For creators seeking to dive deeper into building their digital commerce stack, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates. This kit provides a comprehensive foundation to establish your store effectively. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

You can build your digital store by using GitHub Pages for hosting, Supabase for order management, and NOWPayments for handling crypto transactions. This combination allows you to create a fully functional store without relying on traditional payment platforms.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script for deployment, taking 4-6 hours, while Stack 02 incorporates Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Stack 02 offers a more robust infrastructure with additional features.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are excellent for hosting your digital product store. They provide reliable and free hosting solutions that integrate well with a backend powered by Supabase and NOWPayments.
What tools do I need to set up my order database?

To set up your order database, you'll need Supabase for database management and Google Apps Script for payment processing logic. These tools work together seamlessly to handle orders and transactions efficiently.
How can I ensure my payments are processed quickly?

To ensure quick payment processing, use NOWPayments for crypto transactions. It offers low fees and instant confirmation, enabling you to automate product delivery immediately once a payment is verified.
